hooks.command: bun -e "if(!process.env.ZELLIJ && !process.env.TMUX){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in zellij for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: zellij -s dev, then run \"bun run dev\" inside');console.error('[Hook] Reattach: zellij attach dev');process.exit(2)}"
bun -e "if(!process.env.ZELLIJ && !process.env.TMUX){console.error('[Hook] Consider running in zellij for session persistence');console.error('[Hook] zellij -s dev  |  zellij attach dev')}"
bun -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{console.error('[Hook] Build completed - async analysis running in background');console.log(d)})"

bun -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){let dir=path.dirname(p);while(dir!==path.dirname(dir)&&!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'tsconfig.json'))){dir=path.dirname(dir)}if(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'tsconfig.json'))){try{const r=execSync('bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1',{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe']});const lines=r.split('
').filter(l=>l.includes(p)).slice(0,10);if(lines.length)console.error(lines.join('
'))}catch(e){const lines=(e.stdout||'').split('
').filter(l=>l.includes(p)).slice(0,10);if(lines.length)console.error(lines.join('
'))}}}console.log(d)})"

bun -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const lines=c.split('\n');const matches=[];lines.forEach((l,idx)=>{if(/console\.log/.test(l))matches.push((idx+1)+': '+l.trim())});if(matches.length){console.error('[Hook] WARNING: console.log found in '+p);matches.slice(0,5).forEach(m=>console.error(m));console.error('[Hook] Remove console.log before committing')}}console.log(d)})"
